length.sourceNote: Infobox publishes a range across the whole run, 4980-5021 mm. Stored as the lowest figure.

width.sourceNote: Published as 77.3 in excluding mirrors, converted at 25.4 mm/in.

height.sourceNote: Published as 56.5 in, converted at 25.4 mm/in.

kerbWeight.sourceNote: Infobox publishes a range across the whole run, 4323-4960 lb, converted at 0.45359237 kg/lb (1961-2250 kg). Stored as the lowest figure.

power.sourceNote: Published as 362 hp for the base Signature model's AC induction motor, converted at 1 hp = 0.745699872 kW (269.9 kW, rounded here to 270).

torque.sourceNote: Published as 324 lb-ft, converted at 1 lb-ft = 1.3558179483314004 N-m (439.3 N-m, rounded here to 439).

power.sourceNote: Published as a combined output of 762 hp for the two motors together, converted at 1 hp = 0.745699872 kW (568.2 kW, rounded here to 568). This is the article's own combined figure, not a sum performed here.

torque.sourceNote: Published as a combined 713 lb-ft, converted at 1 lb-ft = 1.3558179483314004 N-m (966.7 N-m, rounded here to 967).

electricRange.sourceNote: Published as 268 mi, converted at 1.609344 km/mi (431.3 km). The article does not name the test cycle; Tesla's US-market spec sheets of this era are standardly EPA-rated, which is the basis for treating this as approximately the EPA figure rather than a WLTP one, but that reading is not stated outright in the source.

power.sourceNote: Published as a combined output of 1020 hp for the three motors together, converted at 1 hp = 0.745699872 kW (760.6 kW, rounded here to 761). The article's own combined figure, not a sum performed here.

torque.sourceNote: Published directly in N-m as the combined figure for all three motors.

topSpeed.sourceNote: Published as 200 mph, converted at 1.609344 km/mi (321.9 km/h, rounded here to 322). The article's 0-60 mph time of 1.98 s is not recorded here — it is not the same quantity as a 0-100 km/h time and no 0-100 km/h figure is published.

dragCoefficient.sourceNote: Claimed at the Plaid's 2021 debut as the lowest of any production car at the time. Earlier, pre-2021 Model S cars claimed 0.24.

hero.alt: White Tesla Model S photographed from the front three-quarter angle at an outdoor event, with a smooth closed front fascia and no visible grille
hero.caption: A post-2021 'Palladium' refresh Model S: the closed nose is a giveaway that there is no engine behind it to cool.

gallery.alt: Dark blue Tesla Model S photographed from the rear three-quarter angle on a paved street, showing the liftback's frameless glass roof and full-width tail light bar
gallery.caption: The liftback tailgate, one of the Model S's less obvious identity marks — it reads as a three-box saloon but opens like a hatchback.
